mechanisms.name: gamma prime precipitate shearing by anti-phase-boundary coupled dislocation pairs

evidence.quote: γ′ precipitate shearing by diffusive slip of APB-coupled dislocation pairs (TMW 1) or diffusive slip of SFs was the suggested as dominant creep mechanism during the steady-state creep stage.
